rca of the issue: Root cause: DiscoverPage previously used 'fixed inset-0' which pinned the wrapper to the full viewport, causing the card to overlap the bottom nav on Android (100dvh unreliable with Capacitor). Fix: wrapper now uses relative flex column with height:calc(100vh - var(--nav-total, 86px)); .discover-card-area uses flex:1 min-h:0. City filter moved to bottom-sheet overlay avoiding status-bar overlap. Verified in mobile viewport that bottom-nav (y=783, h=61) fits inside 844px viewport.
